reviews.title: Safe App, Risky Data Recovery
reviews.text:
I’ve always tried to be careful about protecting my personal data, but with WhatsApp, it doesn’t always feel possible.

There’s no doubt that WhatsApp is a secure and safe platform in terms of encryption. However, the real problem starts when we change or reset our phones. Logging back into the account is usually easy, but restoring old data becomes very risky.

Most people forget their backup passwords, and if end-to-end encrypted backup is enabled, there is absolutely no recovery option without that password. The 64-digit encryption key is also something most users either don’t save or can’t find in urgent situations. In such cases, even if you skip the restore and start using WhatsApp again, all previous chats and memories are permanently lost.

After losing important chats and old data multiple times, I honestly feel disappointed. Security is important, but what’s the use of such strict security if users can’t access their own data when they need it? It feels like the data is protected even from the owner.

Because of these experiences, I now prefer Telegram. It feels safer in a more practical way and makes it much easier to recover old chats without so much risk of permanent loss.
